fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE BUREAU CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CATEGORY OF SUBMITTING INSTITUTION
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc

fields.name: SUBMITTING INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: Institution Code of the submitting instutition. E.g. Bank code issued by KBA (e.g. KCB = 01) for Commercial Banks.

fields.name: FILE NAME
fields.description: The name of the file being submitted. E.g. Credit Application file.

fields.name: BATCH NUMBER
fields.description: The Batch Number of the file.

fields.name: DATE SUBMITTED
fields.description: The date when the file was submitted. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: DATE WHEN LOGS WERE SENT
fields.description: The date when logs were sent to the submitting institution. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: EMAIL OF PERSON RECEIVING LOGS
fields.description: The email address of the person that received the logs sent.

fields.name: REMARKS
fields.description: Any remarks accompanying the records.
fields.example: GI file has invalid column count

fields.name: CATEGORY OF RECORD SUBMITTED
fields.description: Category of record submitted. List drawn from both the current monthly and daily batch files {Non- Individual Consumer and Account Information, Individual Consumer, Employment and Account Information, Stakeholder Information, Guarantor Information, Bounced Cheque Information, Collateral Register, Fraudulent Activities Information, Credit Application Information etc}

fields.name: FILE NAMING CONVENTION STATUS
fields.description: Whether the file naming convention is correct {C}, Incorrect {IC} or the file was not submitted {DNS}

fields.name: FILE FORMAT STATUS
fields.description: Whether the file format is correct {C}, Incorrect {IC} or the file was not submitted {DNS}

fields.name: NUMBER OF EXTRACTS SUBMITTED
fields.description: The number of extracts submitted per each category of records submitted

fields.name: NUMBER OF EXTRACTS ACCEPTED
fields.description: The number of extracts accepted per each category of records submitted

fields.name: NUMBER OF RECORDS SUBMITTED
fields.description: The number of records submitted per each category of extracts submitted

fields.name: NUMBER OF RECORDS ACCEPTED
fields.description: The number of records accepted per each category of extracts submitted

fields.name: NUMBER OF RECORDS REJECTED
fields.description: The number of records rejected per each category of extracts submitted

fields.name: NUMBER OF MANDATORY FIELDS SUBMITED
fields.description: The number of mandatory fields sumitted per each category of records submitted
